items.title: 20.2.1 Tools used in Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tools of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Gene of interest woh gene hai jis par kaam karna hai, yaani jise badalna ya doosre jandar mein dalna hai. Gene of interest in teen tareeqon mein se kisi aik se hasil kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Laboratory mein mukhtalif enzymes (maslan polymerases aur ligases) ki madad se gene of interest ko seedha bana lena (direct synthesis).
Us gene ke mRNA se reverse transcription kar ke gene banana; is ke liye reverse transcriptase enzymes istemal hote hain (yeh mRNA se DNA banate hain).
Restriction endonuclease enzymes se chromosome ko kaat kar gene alag kar lena (cleavage).
